list.name: market
list.label: 市场
list.query: select t.question as __text, t.market_id as __value from tokens t where t.outcome_index = 1 and t.market_id in (select distinct market_id from metrics_book where second > now() - interval '1 hour') order by t.question
list.definition: tokens（最近 1 小时有数据的市场）

panels.title: 数据新鲜度（距最新一条指标）

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from now() - max(computed_at)) as "秒" from metrics_book where second > now() - interval '1 day'

panels.description: 超过 30 秒变红：采集器 / metrics / pg-sink 可能有一个停了

panels.title: 异动榜（Yes 的 log-odds 变化，按 60 分钟绝对值排序）

targets.rawSql:
select * from (
  select distinct on (b.asset_id) t.question as "市场", b.mid as "中间价", b.spread as "价差",
         b.logodds_chg_1m as "1分钟", b.logodds_chg_5m as "5分钟", b.logodds_chg_15m as "15分钟", b.logodds_chg_60m as "60分钟"
  from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id)
  where t.outcome_index = 1 and b.second > now() - interval '5 minutes'
  order by b.asset_id, b.second desc
) x order by abs("60分钟") desc nulls last

panels.description: log-odds 变化：正数 = Yes 涨，绝对值越大变化越大；0.01→0.02 和 0.50→0.51 都是 1 分，但前者的 log-odds 变化大得多

targets.rawSql:
select b.second as time, b.best_bid as "买一", b.mid as "中间价",
  b.best_ask as "卖一", b.microprice as "加权中间价"
from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id) where t.market_id = '$market' and t.outcome_index = 1 and $__timeFilter(b.second) order by 1

select b.second as time, b.logodds_chg_1m as "1分钟", b.logodds_chg_15m as "15分钟",
  b.logodds_chg_60m as "60分钟"
from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id) where t.market_id = '$market' and t.outcome_index = 1 and $__timeFilter(b.second) order by 1

select b.second as time, b.spread as "价差"
from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id) where t.market_id = '$market' and t.outcome_index = 1 and $__timeFilter(b.second) order by 1

panels.title: 盘口不平衡（正 = 买方多）

targets.rawSql:
select b.second as time, b.imbalance_1 as "前1档", b.imbalance_5 as "前5档"
from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id) where t.market_id = '$market' and t.outcome_index = 1 and $__timeFilter(b.second) order by 1

panels.title: 深度（中间价上下多少以内的挂单金额）

targets.rawSql:
select b.second as time, b.bid_depth_1c as "买 ±1分", b.ask_depth_1c as "卖 ±1分",
  b.bid_depth_5c as "买 ±5分", b.ask_depth_5c as "卖 ±5分"
from metrics_book b join tokens t using (asset_id) where t.market_id = '$market' and t.outcome_index = 1 and $__timeFilter(b.second) order by 1

panels.title: 成交流向（每分钟份数）

targets.rawSql:
select tr.minute as time,
  sum(case when t.outcome_index = 1 then tr.buy_volume else tr.sell_volume end) as "看涨（买 Yes / 卖 No）",
  -sum(case when t.outcome_index = 1 then tr.sell_volume else tr.buy_volume end) as "看跌（卖 Yes / 买 No）"
from metrics_trades tr join tokens t using (asset_id)
where tr.market_id = '$market' and $__timeFilter(tr.minute) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: 买 No 和卖 Yes 是同一个方向，所以两个 token 的成交合在一起按 Yes 的角度看

panels.title: 延迟（所有市场，每分钟）

targets.rawSql:
select date_trunc('minute', second) as time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from received_at - exchange_ts)) as "交易所→收到 p50",
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from inserted_at - exchange_ts)) as "交易所→入库 p50",
  percentile_cont(0.99) within group (order by extract(epoch from inserted_at - exchange_ts)) as "交易所→入库 p99"
from metrics_book where $__timeFilter(second) group by 1 order by 1

panels.description: 交易所→收到 是网络 + 采集；之后多出来的主要是「等这一秒结束 + 宽限 3 秒」的设计延迟
